indicator_name: Primary placements of government securities and NBK notes during the month, by instrument and term, million KZT
description: Первичные размещения государственных ценных бумаг и нот НБК за месяц, по видам бумаг и срокам, млн тенге
unit: million KZT, placed during the month
methodology: NBK formId=17 «Government Securities Primary Auctions», 2022-12 onward; items by instrument (MEUKAM, MEOKAM, MEKKAM, METIKAM, METICKAM, MUIKAM, NBK_NOTES, OTHER) and <instrument>.T<months>M by term. Dated by the month of placement (report_date is the 1st of the next month, as the NBK's note auctions; the NBK notes of 2026-09-01 are 942 107 mln = the August 2026 auctions). The stock outstanding is GOV_SECURITIES_OUTSTANDING_BY_TYPE.
